Only that website can read them. In addition, a website might potentially use external services, which also set their own cookies, known as third-party cookies.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePersistent cookies are cookies saved on your computer and that are not deleted automatically when you quit your browser, unlike a session cookie, which is deleted when you quit your browser.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003ch2\u003eWhy do we use cookies?\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003eWe use first-party and third-party cookies for several reasons. Some cookies are required for technical reasons in order for our website to operate, and we refer to these as \"essential\" or \"strictly necessary\" cookies. Other cookies enable us to track and target the interests of our users to enhance the experience. Third parties serve cookies through our website for advertising, analytics, and other purposes.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003eWhat types of cookies do we use?\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003eTo help you better understand the cookies we use on our website, we have categorized them as follows:\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3\u003eCategory 1: Strictly Necessary Cookies\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp\u003eThese cookies are essential for the website to function properly and cannot be switched off in our systems.
